problem: There are $8$ guests standing in a line at the entrance to a theater. The names of the guests are called at random, and whoever is called is allowed in. In how many possible ways can the guests be called?

feedback.problem: How many permutations are there for the letters in the word "MATH"?
feedback.worked_solution:
In the word "MATH" there are a total of $4$ letters with no repeating letters, so there are $4!$ ways of arranging them:

$$
\begin{aligned}4! & =4\times 3\times 2\times 1 \\  & =24.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, there are $24$ possible arrangements of the letters of the word "MATH".
